## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (or [CONTRIBUTING.en.md](../CONTRIBUTING.en.md)).
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds.
- [ ] `npm test` passes (and I added tests for new behavior).
- [ ] `npm run lint` is clean.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (skip for tooling-only or doc-only).
- [ ] Public API / CLI changes are reflected in the README.
- [ ] No `Co-Authored-By:` AI assistant trailers.
